title: Reed Lockwood: Common "Pitfalls" of Roguelike Traps and How to Circumvent Them
speaker: Reed Lockwood
talk_title: Common "Pitfalls" of Roguelike Traps and How to Circumvent Them
description:
Traps are an ever-present but often overlooked and under-designed mechanic in traditional roguelikes. This talk will examine the design considerations that go into a satisfying trap, with the goal of making the dungeon itself a deadly and memorable part of the adventure.

Lead-in music generated by Sonat Uzun.
